description:
After the server exists, DELETE/rotate the provider key. Providers don't let a
    minimal key self-delete via API, so this returns the exact dashboard steps (mirrors
    cloudflare_revoke_token's needs_manual). Give the key the same way (api_key_file=<path>,
    or api_key_cred=<vault id> on the gateway); never echoed.
name: cloud_revoke_key
